title: The Deep Drop
author: E. M. Reyes
blurb: Emrys Villalobos, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
